description: Type the packet-mirroring 'collector ILB not ready' answer (HTTP 400: "Invalid value for field 'resource.collectorIlb.url': '…'. Forwarding Rule specified as collector ILB is not ready"). A just-created internal forwarding rule is briefly not accepted as a collector; it surfaced as the generic BadRequest, so callers matched the message to retry. Observed live 2026-09-29 in us-central1.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The forwarding rule used as the packet-mirroring collector is still being programmed (HTTP 400: 'Forwarding Rule specified as collector ILB is not ready'). Retryable after a few seconds.
